title: Stripping Costs in the Production Phase of a Surface Mine
summary: Addresses accounting for waste removal (stripping) costs incurred in surface mining during the production phase, splitting costs between inventory and a stripping activity asset based on the benefit obtained.

related.title: Inventories
related.relationship: Governs the portion of stripping costs relating to inventory produced in the current period

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: Governs classification and depreciation of the stripping activity asset where it enhances tangible mine infrastructure

related.title: Intangible Assets
related.relationship: Governs classification and amortisation of the stripping activity asset where it enhances an intangible mining right

related.title: Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources
related.relationship: Governs exploration and evaluation expenditure in the phase before production begins

related.title: Impairment of Assets
related.relationship: Governs impairment testing of the stripping activity asset
